purpose: Make EYE the primary integration workspace of janus-meta-registry for representation-aware contextual recovery, provenance-preserving corpus learning, advisory memory, guarded routing, and verification. Existing source artifacts remain canonical at their original paths; EYE indexes and binds them rather than moving or rewriting history.

integrated_organs.EYE: Recover candidate semantic regions by following surviving bridge invariants around lossy, destroyed, opaque, or one-way representations. EYE never upgrades a contextual reconstruction into exact recovery without the corresponding verifier.
integrated_organs.TRUMP: Advisory admission/routing organ. EYE inherits the receipt-grounded R6.3 governance pattern: exact authority lane first, memory assistance only after canonical OPEN, regret-bounded exploration in shadow, fallback preserved, terminal authority retained by exact verification.
integrated_organs.SLIME: Associative and route-memory organ. The bound production candidate is JANUS_ACTIVATOR_SLIME_MEMORY_R0, the executable candidate that passed the frozen Gold-vs-Ideal Activator benchmark. Its authority remains advisory only.
integrated_organs.VERIFY: Independent witness. Verification, not EYE, TRUMP, or SLIME, decides whether an exact candidate matches a frozen digest/source contract or whether a claim remains SEMANTIC_REGION_SUPPORTED, AMBIGUOUS, OPEN, or BLOCKED.

compact_operator: SOURCE + REPRESENTATION_CONTRACT + PROVENANCE + SLIME_MEMORY + TRUMP_ROUTING + EYE_BRIDGES + INDEPENDENT_VERIFY -> INTERPRETABLE_RESULT

role_separation.TRUMP_ROUTES: which lane may be attempted and with what authority
role_separation.SLIME_REMEMBERS: associations, failures, UNKNOWN, cost, and verified route history
role_separation.VERIFY_DECIDES: what result may be asserted under the frozen contract

training_definition.means: deterministic whole-repository ingestion, hashing, provenance/relation graph construction, bridge-token indexing, non-authoritative associative-memory construction, and routing-state derivation
training_definition.promotable_slime_learning: disabled for ordinary corpus documents; only constitution-eligible finalized verified route receipts may update promotable route confidence

seal: EYE SEES THE BRIDGES. TRUMP CHOOSES THE LANE. SLIME REMEMBERS THE PATH. VERIFICATION DECIDES WHAT MAY BE SAID.
